_about: Google AdSense for the public site. The IDs are public by design: they appear in every page's source.

client: your publisher ID, 'ca-pub-' and 16 digits (AdSense -> Account -> Account information). Leave it empty to build without ads: no ad script, no ad slots, no consent link, and the privacy page says there are no ads.
slots: the numeric data-ad-slot of one display ad unit per placement (AdSense -> Ads -> By ad unit -> Display ads). A placement whose slot is empty shows no ad.

mapLeft is a 160 x 600 skyscraper in a column left of the map; forgeLeft and forgeRight are 160 x 600 rails that follow the scroll; all three appear only on screens wide enough for them. mapBottom is a banner below the map; forgeMiddle and forgeEnd are responsive blocks.

guideLeft and guideRight are the guides' 160 x 600 rails, like the forge's; guideTop (after a guide's contents) and guideEnd (before its related guides, and at the end of the guides page) are responsive blocks. Each has its own unit, named 'Site <placement>' in AdSense.
While client is set, the build writes the AdSense tag into content pages (not the privacy page), verification meta into every page's head, and ads.txt at the site root.
